dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, who are you going to talk about in Mr. Brown's class?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, huː ər juː ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ɪn ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊnz ˈklæs?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Celine Dion. She's a Canadian singer and a huge celebrity.
dialogue.reading: seɪˈliːn diˈɑːn. ʃiːz ə kəˈneɪdiən ˈsɪŋər ənd ə ˈhjuːdʒ səˈlɛbrəti.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, I know her songs! When did her career start?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, aɪ ˈnoʊ hɜːr ˈsɔːŋz! ˈwɛn ˈdɪd hɜːr kəˈrɪr ˈstɑːrt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Very early. She was the youngest of fourteen children, and she recorded her first song at twelve.
dialogue.reading: ˈvɛri ˈɜːrli. ʃiː wʌz ðə ˈjʌŋɪst əv ˌfɔːrˈtiːn ˈtʃɪldrən, ənd ʃiː rɪˈkɔːrdɪd hɜːr ˈfɜːrst ˈsɔːŋ ət ˈtwɛlv.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes. By the time she was eighteen, she had already made many albums in French.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. baɪ ðə ˈtaɪm ʃiː wʌz ˌeɪˈtiːn, ʃiː hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈmeɪd ˈmɛni ˈælbəmz ɪn ˈfrɛntʃ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: So when did she become famous worldwide?
dialogue.reading: soʊ wɛn dɪd ʃiː bɪˈkʌm ˈfeɪməs ˌwɜːrldˈwaɪd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: In the 1990s, when she started singing in English.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ðə ˈnaɪntiːn ˈnaɪntiz, wɛn ʃiː ˈstɑːrtɪd ˈsɪŋɪŋ ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And the song from Titanic? Is that when she became a star?
dialogue.reading: ənd ðə ˈsɔːŋ frəm taɪˈtænɪk? ɪz ˈðæt wɛn ʃiː bɪˈkeɪm ə ˈstɑːr?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No. By the time she sang it, she had already won many awards.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. baɪ ðə ˈtaɪm ʃiː ˈsæŋ ɪt, ʃiː hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈwʌn ˈmɛni əˈwɔːrdz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I know! I hope my talk is as good as her songs.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ! aɪ ˈhoʊp maɪ ˈtɔːk ɪz əz ˈɡʊd əz hɜːr ˈsɔːŋz.
